expectation.name: Nvidia
expectation.priceCaption: Recorded Oct 9, 2026 close · Massive · demo position
expectation.note: Illustrative price scenarios, not a forecast. Excludes dividends, fees and tax. Whole shares at the initial price.
expectation.basis: Period return = (1 + annual return / 100)^(months / 12) − 1. Initial investment = initial price × whole shares. Ending value = initial investment × (1 + period return). Rates are assumptions with no assigned likelihood. DCF is long-term valuation context; Piotroski measures financial health. Neither forecasts a short-run return.
expectation.dcfNote: Needs dated financial statements and explicit growth / WACC inputs. Long-term valuation context.
expectation.strengthNote: Needs nine financial criteria; independent of the assumed return.
